p: know ye this day: You who have seen God's graces with your eyes should be moved, rather than your children who have only heard of them.
what he did unto you in: As well concerning his benefits, as his corrections.
all the commandments which I command: Because you have felt both his chastisement and his benefits.
foot: By making gutters for the water to come out of the Nile river to water the land.
the first rain and the latter: In the seed time, and toward harvest.
deceived: By devising foolish devotions according to your own fantasies.
the days of heaven upon the: As long as the heavens and earth endure, 2Pe 3:10,12.
your feet shall tread shall be: This was accomplished in David and Solomon's time.
sea shall your coast be: The Mediterranean.
known: He reproves the malice of men who leave that which is certain to follow that which is uncertain.
where the sun goeth down: Meaning, in Samaria.
